title: Largest Rectangle
difficulty: Hard
position: 14
complexity: O(n)
=== statement
A skyline is made of `n` bars of width 1 standing side by side, with the given heights. Find the area of the largest rectangle that fits inside the skyline.

The area can be larger than a 32-bit integer.
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` heights.
=== output
Print the largest area.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
0 <= height <= 10^9

2 1 5 6 2 3
